attempts.note: Utility library with no external system; the http namespace calls whatever URL the job passes, so no vendor spec can exist. Surface read from src/index.js, src/Adaptor.js, src/http.js, src/beta.js and src/util/http.js.

notes: common (3.3.5) has no vendor API. Its only outbound calls come from the http namespace (http.request with any method, http.get, http.post) against an arbitrary URL, so "full" is that operation surface: GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE at a collection-level (/{resource}) and item-level (/{resource}/{id}) template with an open Resource schema. All 34 ast.json operations (33 public plus the private execute), beta.each and http.options were checked against the source: none makes a request, so they are enumerated in info.x-openfn-local-operations rather than modelled as endpoints (the same treatment every other spec gives common's re-exported helpers). This replaces the July stub's invented /resources and /request paths. Limits: no multi-segment wildcard in OpenAPI 3.0, and response schemas describe no real API.
